**sdd/issue-256-b2/design**

## B2 DESIGN — Antigravity harness adapter + baptism. openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/design.md.

**init() shape:** `brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs` exports async `init({_readDoc,_writeAgents,_repoRoot}={})` + PURE `compileAgentsMd(docs)` + `SOURCE_DOCS[]` + `AGENTS_EMIT_PATH='AGENTS.md'`. Seam-injected like plain/gentle-ai (`_`-prefixed + `_default*`); NEVER throws (read/write guarded, warn+return). init reads 5 canonical docs → compileAgentsMd → writes repo-root AGENTS.md. Emit target AGENTS.md MEASURED (Exp 1). No cli.mjs change (dispatcher backend-agnostic; plain.mjs is n=2 precedent → this is n=3).

**SOURCE_DOCS (Fork B CONFIRMED):** brain/HOME.md, brain/core/methodology/agent-authorities.md (Tier table VERBATIM — Exp 4), harness-contract.md (verb table), sdd-layout.md (layout summary), workflow-governance.md (the 'Four Invariants and Their Gates' table WITH skip labels — the gate-list source, cross-ref GOVERNANCE_JOBS in scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs).

**Fork 5 DECIDED = COMPILE (self-contained), NOT @path/memport import.** Rationale: AGENTS.md is the multi-harness STANDARD; Codex (free secondary smoke) does NOT process memport → would see literal @path. Compiled serves every standard reader; drift closed by the drift-guard test not by import. Exp 5 (@path in Antigravity, ~2min) = cheap PENDING non-blocking human exp; informs future GEMINI.md layer only.

**Staleness drift-guard = regenerate-and-diff (F2 tripwire-as-test).** antigravity.drift.test.mjs reads the 5 REAL SOURCE_DOCS, compiles via compileAgentsMd, asserts byte-equal to committed AGENTS.md → fails on hand-edit OR source-change-without-regen. Mirrors existing house pattern (governance-checks.test.mjs, sdd-layout.test.mjs). Provenance banner NAMES sources for legibility; test is the enforcement.

**Composition (Exp 4 fact):** emitted AGENTS.md = REPO layer only; composes with host ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md (rules+persona), engram MCP, chrome-devtools plugin, any repo GEMINI.md. Emitter controls none. Runbook awareness check ONCE in Half 2.

**managed-paths.mjs literal:** add `'AGENTS.md'` to managed[] (repo root, outside every glob). antigravity.mjs needs NO literal — already covered by `brain/scripts/**` glob (avoid redundant glob+literal). Tasks: confirm managed-paths.test.mjs has no explicit-listing assertion.

**Fork A settings.json (Half 2, TO-VERIFY vs REAL Antigravity — partial Gemini-CLI inheritance):** pre-declare circuit set via settings.json tools.allowed: run_shell_command(npm test / git commit / git push / gh pr create). Location (~/.gemini/settings.json vs project .antigravity/) CONFIRM live. ROLLBACK: save pre-existing settings.json (or note absence); after #247 merges remove exactly the 4 added entries / restore / delete. Hygiene: verify commands with /help (lax namespace hazard); no /memory show|reload exists → sentinel-prompt-in-fresh-session is only context instrument.

**Budget forecast (honest):** ignoreList excludes **/*.test.mjs (tests FREE) but NOT AGENTS.md → generated AGENTS.md COUNTS (forecast-underestimate lesson). antigravity.mjs ~140-190 + AGENTS.md ~130-180 + managed-paths ~1 = ~270-370 counted. 400-line risk MEDIUM-HIGH; AGENTS.md is swing factor. Chained PRs: NO (emitter+output+drift-guard are one coherent unit). If >400: labeled size:exception ('bulk is generated drift-guarded artifact'), NOT artificial split, NOT gate-weakening. Half 2 baptism = human-operated, downstream, NOT in this PR.

**OPEN for owner (STOP-finding guard):** may AGENTS.md join the golden-file ignore-list CLASS? Defensible as policy but MUST NOT be motivated by B2's own budget (self-serving gate-weakening) — surface, don't self-resolve.

**Host caveat:** port-proof (engram auto-discovery, settings.json shape, AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md load order) MEASURED on host `gandalf` (Antigravity CLI 1.1.1, Gemini 3.5 Flash, 2026-07-12), NOT factory Antigravity. Honors TDD, Pin 1 (generate-never-author), STOP-rule (no gate weakened for Antigravity), ADR-0009 English.
